PENTHOUSE GROOVE NEW DJ VIDEO🎧
【DJ Live Streaming vol.10 "PEACE"】

Love is everywhere. Connected by music, united by love.

This time, we're sharing a transition scene from "PASSING RAIN – GONTITI" into "Cavatina – Ramon de Herrera".

From the unique melancholy sound of an acoustic guitar reminiscent of after the rain has passed, to a cinematic sound that makes you feel sad about a fleeting yet peaceful world. Please enjoy the connections that are appropriate for the theme of “PEACE”.

今回は「PASSING RAIN - GONTITI」から「Cavatina · Ramon de Herrera」への繋ぎのシーンをお届け。
雨が過ぎ去った後を思わせる独特の哀愁漂うアコギの音色から、儚くも穏やかな世界を憂うようなシネマティックなサウンドへ。“PEACE”のテーマに相応しい繋ぎをお楽しみください。
